labels.page_width_info: Standard matches the design: about 1650px of content on a 1920px screen, with the page margin on each side on smaller screens.
labels.logo_info: E.g. the brand mark. Works with wide, square and tall images. Without an image or logo text, the store name is shown.
labels.favicon_info: Shown in the browser tab. Scaled down to 32 × 32px.
labels.animations_enabled_info: Content fades in as visitors scroll. Visitors who turn on reduced motion in their device settings never see the animation.
labels.animation_info: Not applied to the first section on a page, so the top of the page shows instantly.
labels.menu_card_help: Customises one card in the mega menu. Pick the collection the menu item links to, or, for other menu items, the same link (page, blog, product). For a menu item that links to "#", leave both empty and type its exact name as the Title. Empty fields use the collection's own.
labels.card_title_info: Leave empty to use the menu item name. For "#" menu items, type the exact menu name here.
labels.card_image_info: Leave empty to use the collection image.
labels.card_text_info: Leave empty to use the collection description.
labels.card_link_info: Only for menu items that don't link to a collection.
labels.shop_all_label_info: Leave empty to use Shop all.
labels.shop_all_link_info: Leave empty to use the menu item's own link, set in Navigation. With no link, it points to #.
labels.logo_text_info: Shown after the logo image, e.g. Oro.
labels.logo_text_accent_info: Shown right after the text, in italic and the primary colour, e.g. Skin.
labels.transparent_header_info: Floats over the first section, showing only the buttons, and becomes the full header when visitors scroll.
